findings.current: It had been exactly thirty days since I’d logged out.
findings.defect: Reverses when Logout happens: the Korean is Logout after exactly thirty days in-game, not thirty days after a prior Logout.
findings.rationale: 만의 로그아웃 marks the Logout that has just come at the thirty-day mark. “since I’d logged out” places Logout in the past and contradicts the still-in-capsule test that follows.

findings.correction: Looking at me standing there flustered, Jinho hyung sighed.
findings.current: Jinho hyung sighed as he looked at me in confusion.
findings.defect: 당황한 modifies the narrator; the English makes Jinho the confused one.
findings.rationale: 당황한 나를 보며 is Jinho regarding a panicked Taekyung, then sighing. “looked at me in confusion” assigns that state to Jinho.
findings.source: 당황한 나를 보며 진호 형이 한숨을 내쉬었다.

findings.correction: “Honghwaru, my ass. Just close the capsule door.”
findings.current: “Yeah, right. Just close the capsule door.”
findings.defect: Drops the specific scoff at Honghwaru; generic disbelief replaces the echo.
findings.rationale: He repeats 홍화루 to dismiss the instruction, not merely to refuse in general.
findings.source: “홍화루 같은 소리 하네. 캡슐 문이나 닫아.”

findings.correction: My head hurts from the hangover, my uvula hurts, and my heart hurts looking at you.
findings.current: My head hurts from my hangover, my throat hurts, and my heart hurts every time I look at you.
findings.defect: 목젖 in the hangover triad is the uvula gag already established; “throat” flattens it.
findings.rationale: The line stacks hangover, the uvula strike, and hurt feelings. 목젖 is the same word used for the hit, not a generic throat.
findings.source: 숙취 때문에 머리도 아프고 목젖도 아프고 널 보는 내 마음도 아프다.

findings.correction: the bastards who fired up a factory … should have been dragged before a judge.
findings.current: anyone who had fired up a factory … should have been dragged before a judge.
findings.defect: 새끼들 is a slur; “anyone” sanitizes the speaker’s register.
findings.rationale: Rules require matching profanity/insult strength. 새끼들 is not a neutral indefinite.
findings.source: 공장 돌리는 새끼들은 법정에 세워야 한다는 게 내 생각이다.

findings.defect: 골 때리네 is blunt slang, not an f-word; the added profanity is repeated for both speakers.
findings.rationale: Same line is Taekyung’s reaction and Jinho’s deadpan verdict. Intensifying it with “fucking” changes register without a matching source curse.

findings.correction: Jinho hyung stared a hole through me, then spoke.
findings.current: Jinho hyung stared at me for a long time before speaking.
findings.defect: 뚫어져라 is intensity of the stare, not duration.
findings.rationale: The verb marks a piercing look while he decides, not that a long time passed.
findings.source: 진호 형은 나를 뚫어져라 응시하다가 입을 열었다.

findings.correction: By now he had to be too busy at Honghwaru trying to figure out what was going on…
findings.current: By now, he must be running around Honghwaru trying to figure out what’s going on…
findings.defect: Adds “running around”; the Korean is only that he’d be too busy/overwhelmed making sense of the situation.
findings.rationale: 정신이 없을 describes mental overload, not a new physical action.
findings.source: 지금쯤이면 홍화루에서 사태 파악하느라 정신이 없을…….

summary: Critical timeline reversal on Logout; confusion assigned to the wrong person; Honghwaru scoff and uvula callback dropped; insult sanitized.
